mintAuthority.summary: aUSDT is minted by KYC-verified, whitelisted users depositing XAUT into Tether's CMPVault at up to 75% MTV, but Tether centrally controls the whitelist (PermissionControl), can blacklist/freeze, and administers the upgradeable vault contracts. The EIP-1967 ProxyAdmin for the aUSDT token (0xd32645695868555918c5c0c8339c71b84c9240de) is owned by a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828) with no modules and no guard.

controls.label: Alloy CMPVault (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint capped at 75% maximum mint-to-value of deposited XAUT collateral per CMP.
controls.evidence: Verified, whitelisted addresses mint aUSDT by depositing XAUT into the CMPVault up to a 75% MTV liquidation point; minting is permissionless only for KYC-passed addresses.

controls.label: Tether PermissionControl whitelist + token admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295200, aUSDT token EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returns 0xd32645695868555918c5c0c8339c71b84c9240de (ProxyAdmin contract). ProxyAdmin owner() returns 0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828. getOwners() on that address returns 6 addresses; threshold (dc8452cd) = 3; getModulesPaginated returns empty array; guard slot = 0x0; fallbackHandler slot = 0x0. Confirmed as 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe with no modules.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295200: aUSDT token EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0xd32645695868555918c5c0c8339c71b84c9240de (ProxyAdmin); ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828 (Safe); Safe.getOwners() = 6 addresses; Safe threshold = 3; getModulesPaginated = empty; guard = 0x0; fallbackHandler = 0x0. The aUSDT token owner() also returns the same Safe address. KYC-gated CMPVault mint with centralized Safe admin confirmed.
